title: Quenched Late Night British Red Wine Welsh Rarebit
description: A midnight craving dish featuring red wine, soffritto base, low-calorie friendly, served in a scallop shell. Inspired by the traditional British Welsh Rarebit.
instructions: Melt the butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced shallots and cook until they start to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the red wine and cook until reduced by half, about 2 minutes.
Add the flour and whisk to combine. Cook for 1 minute.
Slowly pour in the heavy cream, whisking continuously. Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the grated cheddar cheese and stir until melted and smooth.
Stir in the Worcestershire sauce and nutritional yeast.
Season with black pepper to taste.
Pour the mixture into a scallop shell or individual ramekins.
Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
Broil until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes.
